reason.evidence.sourced: It is backed by published injury statistics, linked under Sources.
reason.evidence.verify: We are still double-checking the numbers behind this one, so treat its place in the list as a best estimate.
reason.unlock: This risk starts in about {months} months, so it is a good time to get ahead of it.

help.title: Help
help.poisonText: Free, 24 hours a day. Call right away if a child may have swallowed something harmful. Don't wait for symptoms.
help.call911: If a child isn't breathing, can't be woken or is having a seizure, call 911.
help.soon: Checked Texas resources will be listed here.
people.title: People
people.soon: Sharing isn't ready yet. It will arrive in an update.
people.noHelpers: Names you assign to tasks will show up here.
settings.title: Settings
settings.eraseText: This removes your children, homes and task progress from this phone. You can't undo it.
privacy.title: Privacy and how this works
privacy.1: Everything you enter stays on this device. There are no accounts and no tracking.
privacy.2: Advice comes from linked sources that people reviewed. AI does not write it.
privacy.3: The app can't see your home, so it can't tell you a hazard is gone. Check each fix yourself.
privacy.aiTitle: How AI helped build this app
privacy.aiText: AI tools helped write this app's code. They did not write the advice. The project logs its AI use in the AI_USE file.

weekend.timeHeading: How much time do you have?
weekend.nothingFits: Nothing fits in that time and budget. Try more time or a bigger budget.
weekend.nothingOpen: Every task here is already done.
weekend.rankNote: Ranked by how serious each hazard is for {name}'s age. A priority order, not a prediction.
